name: kaigobiz
description: High-performance TypeScript GoBiz/GoPay Payment Gateway & Scraper

scripts.build: tsc && vite build && tsup src/widget/kaigobiz-widget.ts --format iife --global-name KaiGoBiz --out-dir dist --minify && (cp dist/kaigobiz-widget.global.js dist/kaigobiz.js 2>/dev/null || cp dist/kaigobiz-widget.js dist/kaigobiz.js 2>/dev/null || true)
